name: Yuuwaku no Danchizuma-tachi ~Kairaku ni Oboreru Ureta Niku~
original_name: 誘惑の団地妻たち　～快楽に溺れる熟れた肉～
source:
It was just before summer vacation.
I was in a bit of a bind, rent was high and I was broke, so I asked my uncle if there was somewhere I could crash for a while.
It turned out he was looking for a building manager for the summer.
Awesome.

At first I had no idea how to deal, but the women in the apartment complex were very friendly and helped me help them in various ways.

Then, one day.
An especially hot wife named Midori-san asked me to fix her fan,
and I was able to get a good look at her in the shower.
"You scoundrel," she chided. "I'll forgive you if you help me with something."

Midori-san, it seems, was looking for friendship.
"Be my friend. Be friendly with me. Can you do that? It's not hard..."
She smiled strangely as she invited me in.
I was welcomed into the wives' club, as a friend to all married women.
Did I really have any choice?

The days that followed were a gambit of milf conspiracy.
Oh, the things I saw in that hot secluded room.

translation:
那是在暑假前夕。

我遇到了点麻烦：房租很贵，而我身无分文，于是向叔叔打听有没有地方能让我暂住一阵子。

结果，他正好在寻找一名暑期楼栋管理员。

太棒了。

起初，我完全不知道该如何应付，但公寓里的女性们都非常友善，还以各种方式帮助我，让我也能帮助她们。

然后，有一天。

一位格外火辣的太太翠小姐请我修理电风扇，我因此得以好好看了一番她在淋浴时的模样。

“你这个卑鄙小人。”她责备道，“只要你帮我做件事，我就原谅你。”

翠小姐似乎是在寻找朋友。

“和我做朋友吧。对我友好一点。你能做到吗？这并不难……”

她露出奇怪的笑容，邀请我进屋。

我被迎进了太太们的圈子，成为所有已婚女性的朋友。

我真的有选择吗？

接下来的日子里，尽是熟女们的阴谋诡计。

啊，我在那间炎热而隐蔽的房间里看到了多少不得了的东西啊。
